name: Choripán
author: munchery.com
steps: Grill the Chorizos: Cook the chorizos on a grill or pan until fully cooked, about 10-15 minutes.
Prepare the Rolls: Slice the rolls and toast them lightly on the grill or in a pan.
Assemble: Slice each chorizo lengthwise and place in a roll. Top with a generous amount of chimichurri sauce.
Grill the chorizo slowly on medium heat to prevent the skin from bursting and to ensure it cooks evenly throughout.
Toast the bread on the grill to absorb some of the chorizo's flavors.

culture.text: Choripán is a type of asado sandwich with grilled chorizo. It is popular in Argentina, Chile, Uruguay, Paraguay, Peru, Ecuador, Bolivia and Venezuela. The name comes from the combination of the names of its ingredients: a grilled chorizo sausage and a crusty bread such as a pan batido, baguette, or francés.
